title: helm(private): enhance values schema, init hooks and add upgrade/rollback support for private installer
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private installer upgrades surfaced two recurring issues: silent misconfiguration due to permissive values.yaml and lack of safe upgrade/rollback primitives for on-prem operators. This PR introduces a stricter values.schema.json, optional init hooks (storage and network prechecks), and templated upgrade/rollback Kubernetes Job manifests to standardize operator workflows. Changes are designed to be backwards-compatible by accepting legacy keys and emitting deprecation warnings. What I changed: - Add charts/redwood-private/values.schema.json with JSON Schema validation and clear error messages for top-level fields (replicas, storage, network, init.*, upgrade.*, rollback.*) and migration notes. - Implement templates: templates/init-storage-job.yaml (pre-install hook, idempotent storage checks), templates/init-network-checks.yaml (optional network connectivity checks), templates/upgrade-job.yaml (templated Job for in-place upgrades with artifact pinning and safety gates), templates/rollback-job.yaml (manual rollback Job with safeguards). - Make hooks optional via values (init.enableNetworkChecks, init.enableStorageInit) to support air-gapped installs. - Update values.yaml defaults to be conservative and non-breaking. - Update Chart README with upgrade/rollback docs and migration guidance. - Add unit and helm-integration tests; reworked a flaky backoff setting causing an intermittent e2e failure. Checklist: - [x] values schema added and validated in CI - [x] init hooks implemented and optional - [x] upgrade/rollback jobs templated and documented - [x] unit & helm-integration tests updated - [x] README migration section added Notes: legacy keys are tolerated but will log deprecation warnings at runtime. Follow-up: automate migration warnings via the operator controller (ENG-9237).

additional_context: This change addresses multiple customer-reported upgrade incidents. The values.schema.json prevents silent misconfiguration by validating top-level fields and providing actionable errors. Init jobs run as pre-install hooks to verify storage and network readiness; they are optional to support restricted environments. Upgrade/rollback Jobs provide a standardized, idempotent operator workflow and are intentionally manual by default. Changes are covered by unit and helm-integration tests and a targeted e2e run against a private-installer scenario. Follow-up work: add automated migration assistance in the operator (ENG-9237) and surface deprecation warnings in logs and the console.
